name: Korea Alcohol Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Korea Alcohol Industrial Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of chemical products in South Korea and internationally. It offers industrial, refined, and edible ethanol; petrochemical products, including ethyl and butyl acetate; color pastes; and electronic grade normal butyl acetate and absolute ethanol. The company also engages in real estate development, leasing, and investment business. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Yongin-si, South Korea.
